descriptions: A shingle beach at the edge of a long black loch. Out in the water the roofs of a great hall break the surface, and a causeway of stepping stones leads out to them.
features: A rowing boat drawn up and chained, its oars long gone.
ambient: A bell tolls somewhere under the water.

descriptions: A great hall up to the knee in water, its long tables rotting under the surface.
A hall where the loch comes in through the windows, green light rippling on the ceiling.
features: Gold cups still set out along a sunken table.
ambient: Your footsteps send slow rings across the water.

descriptions: A high-roofed chamber with a throne at the far end, weed hanging from its arms like a cloak.
The king's chamber, the dais dry, the throne empty, a crown-shaped mark on the seat.
features: Banners so rotten you can't tell the colours.
ambient: Water drips into the silence, louder than it should be.

descriptions: A walkway above the flooded hall, its rail long gone, its boards soft underfoot.
features: A harp with every string snapped.

descriptions: Stone tombs half under water, their lids pushed aside from within.
A low vault of drowned graves, each with a carved warrior asleep on top.
features: One tomb, sealed, with fresh scratches on the inside of the lid.
ambient: The water around your ankles is very cold.

descriptions: A causeway of great flat stones crossing open water between the hall's wings.
Stepping stones, slick with weed, with deep water either side.
features: Mussel beds along the stones, some of them pearl-bearing.
ambient: A long ripple crosses the loch and passes on.
